plan.title: [framework-gap] Human-presence mint: agent-shell marker list has no Grok entry

narratives.Description: [framework-gap] Human-presence mint: agent-shell marker list has no Grok entry
narratives.Overview: Prefer-A Recut-2 Bound 6453002013 (+ T5 amend 6453463532): add GROK_AGENT then GROK_SESSION_ID to AUTHZ_AGENT_SHELL_ENV_MARKERS; export detectedAgentShellMarkers returning matching keys in list order; looksLikeAgentShell is length>0; shared refuseNonInteractiveMint names every matched key with unset hint and never prints values; blank/whitespace marker values return [].
narratives.UserStory: As an operator minting from a real console, I want Grok Build agent shells refused by the human-presence mint denylist with a named-key unset hint, so that a TTY-bearing Grok tool shell cannot slip past agent-shell detection.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. After OPENAI_CODEX in AUTHZ_AGENT_SHELL_ENV_MARKERS add exact GROK_AGENT then GROK_SESSION_ID (non-empty-after-trim; no GROK_* prefix; both unconditional).
2. Export detectedAgentShellMarkers(environ) returning every matching key in list order; looksLikeAgentShell = length>0; change shared refuseNonInteractiveMint to name every matched key, include unset hint, never print values.
3. Keep GROK_AGENT on the denylist (P3 residual diagnosable via named-unset message).
4. Tests T1–T6 per Bound + plan amend 6453463532: T5 blank/whitespace values return empty list [] not null; extend scope-record-approved-scope per-verb loop with GROK_AGENT and GROK_SESSION_ID.
5. CHANGELOG Unreleased Fixed. Tracking/Refs only on product PR.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Prefer-A Recut-2 Bound 6453002013 + T5 amend 6453463532: membership, plural detectedAgentShellMarkers, named-unset refusal, blank to empty-list tests, and CHANGELOG Fixed are independently checkable against human-presence-mint.ts/tests.

items.title: relieves: P1 — Add exact env names GROK_AGENT then GROK_SESSION_ID to AUTHZ_AGENT_SHELL_ENV_MARKERS after OPENAI_CODEX with non-empty-after-trim matching, no GROK_* prefix match, and both markers unconditional with the session-id-only fallback struck.

relieves: P2 — Export detectedAgentShellMarkers(environ) returning every matching key in list order, implement looksLikeAgentShell as length > 0, and change the single shared refuseNonInteractiveMint message so every mint caller names those keys, includes an unset hint, and never prints values.

relieves: P3 — Keep GROK_AGENT on the denylist so dual-use false refuses stay diagnosable and recoverable through the P2 named-unset message, knowingly carrying the residual that a human profile export is still refused rather than dropping the strong marker.
